name: Mastra
what: A TypeScript framework for AI apps and agents. It includes model routing across 40+ providers, agents with tools, graph-based workflows with suspend/resume, memory and RAG, MCP server authoring, evals and observability, plus a local Studio UI. Apache-2.0, except code in ee/ folders, which uses an enterprise license.
who: JavaScript and TypeScript developers who want to add agents to a Next.js, React or Node app.

setup.text: Follow the prompts to pick a project name and model provider, then add your API key to .env.
Start the dev server and open Mastra Studio at http://localhost:4111 to test agents and workflows.

prompts: Create a Mastra agent with a tool that fetches weather for a city.
Build a Mastra workflow that pauses for human approval before publishing a post.
Expose my Mastra tools as an MCP server.
